classification_rules.implemented_non_primary: implemented but not established as primary runtime path
classification_rules.conditional: depends on configuration, credentials or optional provider availability
classification_rules.planned_future: documented future intent without current runtime evidence
classification_rules.reserved_minimal: repository structure exists without completed runtime semantics
classification_rules.unverified: insufficient evidence for the asserted runtime relationship

graph_contract.evidence_rule: Every architectural assertion must be traceable to repository code or governing documentation.
graph_contract.no_inference_rule: Imports, directory presence, naming or a generic module listing alone do not prove runtime invocation.
graph_contract.architectural_rule: The Intelligent Operating Platform and Digital Export Manager spine is the primary explanatory structure; repository evidence refines it rather than replacing it.

validation.rule: Do not claim exhaustive graph coverage until all required architecture domains and their relationships have been reconciled directly into this graph.
